reproduction_note: NOTEBOOK.md 2026-09-04 quotes 9.4e-16 as the worst relative error against equation (32). That identifies the normalisation the original used: it is the scaled measure, and E4 gives 9.39e-16. But it was not the worst of the three - E3 gives 1.31e-15 under the same measure, about 40 per cent larger. The conclusion is unaffected, since agreement is a few ulp of the largest feature value either way, but the figure as quoted understates the worst case. The pointwise measure, about 2e-14, is a different question and is recorded alongside so the two cannot be confused again. See Q15.
